notes.title: 1.4.2 demo update!
notes.content: [p]the demo now has the optimization updates and should better reflect how well the game runs on your machine![/p]

[p]In an update that I may have taken too long to get to I have put some work into optimizing the game to be better played on weaker systems! I doubt it's perfect but it should run much better now. There are also a few missed text and grammar issues that are fixed. [/p]

notes.title: 1.4 Content Update and Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[h2]New equipment![/h2][p]We got Scythes and Lyres and Rapiers and more![/p][p]and not just weapons there’s new accessories that’ll give your builds not just some more flexibility but offer some fun gimmicks to try building around![/p][p]
[/p][h2]Hard difficulty has been added![/h2][p]This difficulty only affects combat and not only features enemies whose stats increase much faster over the course of the month but bosses will also gain new moves! of course with this new mode with harder scaling comes adjustments to account for it. in summary the harder parts of normal difficulty have become easier to account for hard mode scaling while maintaining hard difficulty requiring optimal play to stay alive.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Many encounters have had their difficulty changed across all difficulty levels.[/p][list][*][p]Weekend interloper battles have been made stronger overall[/p][/*][*][p]Antlion has been made more dangerous[/p][/*][*][p]Final area enemies have been made weaker overall[/p][/*][*][p]Secret boss enemies have been given lower stats and weaker abilities to make them possible to beat in hard difficulty (and consequently, easier in normal difficulty!)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]A few abilities have also been tweaked as well[/p][list][*][p]Fujin Tango now does less damage when hitting the same target[/p][/*][*][p]Getting taunted by an enemy reduces damage you deal with multi target attacks by half (lyres are exempt)[/p][/*][*][p]reduced cost of monstrous rush[/p][/*][*][p]Spooky laughs effect has been given a reduced turn count[/p][/*][*][p]Scorcher now has reduced damage but a greatly increased chance of burning targets.[/p][/*][*][p]The Carnivore Claws life steal has been reduced to reflect the actual displayed number and not 10 times that amount, sorry![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028161/4cd79afad4b0369b63c9304aedb8a36345c6107a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Demo!
notes.content: [p]I have finally updated the demo from the Next Fest demo that I forgot to take down to one based on the version of the game about to come out tomorrow! call it a sneak preview if you want I just wanted to have a demo up sooner rather than later. Look forward to the 1.4 update tomorrow![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028161/4cd79afad4b0369b63c9304aedb8a36345c6107a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update plans! Demo to be replaced soon!
notes.content:
[p]For a while now I've been thinking of giving this game at LEAST one content update. The first time it goes on sale for the steam summer sale feels like a pretty good time for that! For this update there are a few new additions![/p][p]  [/p][h2]MORE EQUIPMENT![/h2][p]
I've had some ideas kicking around for a bit for new weapon types that can cover a few untouched niches as well as filling out the list of accessories a bit more. a few of the more interesting new options are...
[/p][list][*][p]Scythes: Stylish and edgy, they do not increase your attack very much but instead increase your critical hit damage!
[/p][/*][*][p]Rapiers: Two hit dress swords that give you a boost of both Dexterity and Agility!
[/p][/*][*][p]Sparrow Brooch: Gain a resistance to wind damage as well as in inherent chance to dodge attacks! however you will also gain a small weakness to physical damage.
[/p][/*][*][p]Burning Heart: Gain a resistance to fire damage and a boost to maximum health as well as gaining more power as your hp is lost! however you will also gain a weakness to water.
[/p][/*][*][p]And more!
 [/p][/*][/list][h2]HARD DIFFICULTY![/h2][p] This is the real meat of the update, at least for me. The Unlife of Gorlak is meant to get pretty hard at some points but pretty soon after release I realized it could get harder. Of course I wouldn't be satisfied with just making the enemies just have higher stats I will also be giving the bosses their own slights and or taunts putting them on the same playing field as you! There have also been some re-balances to later game enemies that will make them less challenging in normal difficulty.[/p][p]  [/p][h2]A New Demo![/h2][p][/p][p]The demo that was present is from next fest and I forgot to take down after that was over. I have decided to take down the demo so that it can be replaced with a new one that better represents how the game plays and runs![/p]

notes.title: Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
during a recent watch of the game it was discovered that the weapon that specifically makes your crits better was making them worse so i fixed that! It also turns out that the equip that increased your crit damage also didn't work so i redesigned it to give you a new ability!

fixed typos
fixed doubled up text boxes in a few places
added flavour text to Battle Beret
Increased gold dropped by enemies in the City
gave enemies in the city better item drops
Added text in the battle tutorial explaining that you can run from battles (as well as an extra reminder during an especially hard optional fight)
Murderer axe now replaces your basic attack with Murder which has increased critical hit chance (it was just not increasing the hit chance before, sorry)
Killer Eye now grants the sleight Killer Jab instead of increasing your critical hit damage (this was also just straight up not working but i think this is a good compromise and fits into focus based crit builds pretty well)
Reduced power of Warlock Crash slightly
Standardized the failure results of some events
Fixed a battle check saying it rolls strength when it’s actually rolling skulk
City Shopkeeper now properly leaves the event pool when you’ve visited enough to find her yourself
fixed visual mistakes in some scenes

notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.content:
Playthroughs are now properly counted and Twists of Fate can be gained
there is now a message that appears when you get a twist of fate
Black and White’s sprites properly appear during the normal and good endings
Increased chance for an enemy to be stunned each turn by Spooky Laugh
Fixed White’s lair talk sprite
properly hiding the necromancers “more” option when there are no extra dialogues unlocked.
fixed the flooded hallway event having a bad 

my apologies for the issues caused by some of these bigger ones. hopefully the more glaring issues from launch are all fixed so that i can focus on figuring out getting a linux build to work properly.
